minor.issue: No public DELETE endpoint for ar_incoming_payments records — testing leaves 4 QA-created payment rows visible in the AR panel table (matched, cannot be removed via API). Cosmetic only; match_log & credits also lack cleanup endpoints.

Public webhook (no signature verification stub, expected — flagged in code comment) but body accepts arbitrary property_id from caller — an attacker could enqueue synthetic messages against any property; acceptable for MVP, worth an auth guard in prod.

action_items: (Optional) Provide DELETE endpoints or admin cleanup route for ar_incoming_payments / ar_match_log / ar_credits so future QA test data can be scrubbed. Currently the AR panel shows lingering 'QA Recon Co' payment rows after tests.
(Optional) Consider adding a soft signature/HMAC on POST /api/inbox/webhook/{channel} for real Twilio/Meta ingress before production.
critical_code_review_comments: nl_automation.py line 69 heuristic condition: `"value": "balayı" and tag` is a truthy-short-circuit bug — the `'balayı' and tag` expression always evaluates to `tag`, but the code appears to intend `'balayı' if tag=='balayı' else tag`; harmless (value is still set to `tag`) but the expression looks accidental. Consider simplifying to `"value": tag`.

waitlist.py _availability uses room_type name matching between rooms.name and bookings.room_type which is a fragile string join — booking creation is elsewhere and if room_type field diverges the count could be off. A join on room_type_id would be safer.

ar_recon_agent._subset_match caps to combinations of up to 6 across at most 12 open invoices — O(C(12,6)) is fine but the pruning by balance size may miss valid subsets that include small invoices. Acceptable heuristic; document behavior.

inbox_agent.agent_handle_inbound resolves property_id from cfg fallback which may be 'all'; _load_faq handles that but the LLM system prompt includes all-property FAQ — not a bug, just be aware for multi-property tenants.
unified_inbox.inbound_webhook is public and does not throttle — production risk (spam). Add IP-based rate limit or channel-secret verification.
city_ledger.delete_invoice must not remove paid invoices without audit trail — currently deletes any invoice (verified in test: it 404s only on missing id). Consider soft-delete with reason.
